exams.name: Insurance Producer Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of lines of authority applied for, duties and responsibilities, and insurance laws, rules, and regulations of Nebraska.
exams.jurisdiction: state (director-administered, may contract with outside testing service)
exams.quote: A resident individual applying for an insurance producer license shall pass a written examination unless exempt pursuant to section 44-4056 or 44-4069 or subsection (4) of section 44-9304.

interval_years.quote: all producers licenses shall expire on the last day of the month of the producer's birthday in the first year after issuance in which his or her age is divisible by two

required.quote: An insurance producer license shall remain in effect unless revoked or suspended if the fee set forth in section 44-4064 is paid and education requirements for resident individual producers are met by the due date.

available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to section 44-4059, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident insurance producer license if: (a) The person is currently licensed as a resident and in good standing in his or her home state

requirements.value: Nonresident must be currently licensed and in good standing in home state, submit proper request and fees, submit home-state application or uniform application, and home state must award nonresident licenses to Nebraska residents on the same basis.
requirements.quote: The director shall waive any requirements for a nonresident insurance producer license applicant with a valid license from his or her home state, except the requirements imposed by section 44-4055, if the applicant's home state awards nonresident licenses to residents of this state on the same basis.

value: Variable life and variable annuity products
Any other line of insurance permitted under Nebraska laws, rules, or regulations
lines_of_authority.quote: An insurance producer may receive qualification for a license in one or more of the following lines of authority: (a) Life insurance coverage on human lives... (b) Accident and health or sickness... (c) Property insurance... (d) Casualty insurance... (e) Variable life and variable annuity products... (f) Limited line credit insurance; (g) Limited line pre-need funeral insurance; (h) Personal lines property and casualty insurance... (i) Any other line of insurance permitted under Nebraska laws, rules, or regulations.

resident_license_available.quote: A person applying for a resident insurance producer license shall make application to the director on the uniform application

nonresident_license_available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to section 44-4059, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident insurance producer license

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer is required to obtain an insurance producer license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The business entity has designated a licensed producer responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws, rules, and regulations of this state.

temporary_license_available.quote: The director may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days without requiring an examination

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The director may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance producer shall not act as an agent of an insurer unless the insurance producer becomes an appointed agent of that insurer.

appointment_fee.value: Fee set by statute reference to section 44-4064; paid by insurer per producer appointed, with a renewal appointment fee also required.
appointment_fee.quote: An insurer shall pay an appointment fee, in the amount and method of payment set forth in section 44-4064, for each insurance producer appointed by the insurer.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: shall notify the director within thirty days following the effective date of the termination

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: An insurance producer shall report to the director any administrative action taken against the producer in another jurisdiction, by a professional self-regulatory organization such as the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority or a similar organization, or by another governmental agency within thirty days of the final disposition of the matter.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The director may verify the insurance producer's licensing status through the producer database maintained by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners or its affiliates or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A person licensed as an insurance producer in another state who moves to this state shall make application within ninety days of establishing legal residence to become a resident licensee

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An individual insurance producer who allows his or her license to lapse may, within twelve months from the due date of the renewal fee, reinstate the same license without the necessity of passing a written examination.
